# 1.) Big ROI - Main Fig
## Load
```{r}
file_path <- "~/Documents/CloudCompare_HistogramValues.csv"  # change if needed

df <- read_delim(
  file = file_path,
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  # CloudCompare sometimes leaves an empty last column because of trailing ;
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>%
  rename(
    class = `Class`,
    count = `Value`,
    start = `Class start`,
    end   = `Class end`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    class = as.integer(class),
    count = as.numeric(count),
    start = as.numeric(start),
    end   = as.numeric(end),
    mid   = (start + end) / 2,
    width = end - start
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(count), is.finite(start), is.finite(end), width > 0)

```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = mid, y = count)) +
  geom_col(width = df$width[1]) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "CloudCompare Distance Histogram",
    x = "Bioprint Result to Map Absolute Distance (µm)",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

## Rebin to 0.5 µm
```{r}
# Rebin
rebin_hist <- function(df, new_binwidth = 0.5) {

  df <- df %>%
    filter(is.finite(start), is.finite(end), is.finite(count),
           end > start, count >= 0) %>%
    arrange(start)

  # Define new bin edges (rounded to the new bin width)
  min_edge <- floor(min(df$start) / new_binwidth) * new_binwidth
  max_edge <- ceiling(max(df$end)  / new_binwidth) * new_binwidth
  edges <- seq(min_edge, max_edge, by = new_binwidth)

  out <- tibble(
    start = edges[-length(edges)],
    end   = edges[-1],
    count = 0
  )

  # Distribute old bin counts into new bins proportional to overlap
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    a <- df$start[i]
    b <- df$end[i]
    c <- df$count[i]
    w <- b - a
    if (w <= 0 || c == 0) next

    # which new bins overlap this old bin?
    j0 <- max(1, floor((a - min_edge) / new_binwidth) + 1)
    j1 <- min(nrow(out), ceiling((b - min_edge) / new_binwidth))

    for (j in j0:j1) {
      oa <- max(a, out$start[j])
      ob <- min(b, out$end[j])
      overlap <- ob - oa

      if (overlap > 0) {
        out$count[j] <- out$count[j] + c * (overlap / w)
      }
    }
  }

  out %>%
    mutate(
      mid   = (start + end) / 2,
      width = end - start
    )
}

```

```{r}
df_05um <- rebin_hist(df, new_binwidth = 0.5)


# Sanity check
c(
  original_total = sum(df$count),
  rebinned_total = sum(df_05um$count)
)

```

```{r}
new_grad <- c("#EFEDC8", "#84B56E", "#408B80", "#31618C", "#0E1424")

ggplot(df_05um, aes(x = mid, y = count, fill = mid)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 25),
    breaks = seq(0, 25, by = 2),
    expand = c(0, 0),
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.004, 0)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = new_grad,
    limits  = c(0, 26),
    oob     = scales::squish,
    name    = "C2M\nDistance (µm)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CloudCompare C2M Distance Histogram (0.5 µm bins)",
    x = "Bioprint Result to Map Absolute Distances (µm)",
    y = "Number of Sampled Mesh Vertices"
  )
```

## Plot
```{r}
binw <- 0.5

# weighted mean and SD from the binned histogram
N <- sum(df_05um$count)

mu <- weighted.mean(df_05um$mid, w = df_05um$count, na.rm = TRUE)
sd <- sqrt(sum(df_05um$count * (df_05um$mid - mu)^2) / (N - 1))

# Gaussian curve scaled to counts per bin
xgrid <- seq(0, 26, by = 0.01)
gauss_df <- data.frame(
  x = xgrid,
  y = N * binw * dnorm(xgrid, mean = mu, sd = sd)
)

new_grad <- c("#EFEDC8", "#84B56E", "#408B80", "#31618C", "#0E1424")

prtin1_histogram <- ggplot(df_05um, aes(x = mid, y = count, fill = mid)) +
  geom_col(width = binw) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 18, color = "#B64249", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(
    data = gauss_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = "#5E5E5E"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 26),
    breaks = seq(0, 26, by = 2),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.005, 0)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = new_grad,
    limits  = c(0, 26),
    oob     = scales::squish,
    name    = "Absolute \nDistance (µm) "
  ) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Gauss: mean = %.2f / std.dev. = %.2f", mu, sd),
    x = "Bioprint Result to Bioprint Map Absolute Distance (µm)",
    y = "Number of Sampled Mesh Vertices"
  )

ggsave(
  "Print1_Histogram.png",
  prtin1_histogram,
  width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 600
)


prtin1_histogram
```
## Stats
```{r}
threshold <- 18

pct_tbl <- df_05um %>%
  mutate(
    frac_below = pmax(0, pmin(end, threshold) - start) / (end - start),
    count_below = count * frac_below,
    frac_above = pmax(0, end - pmax(start, threshold)) / (end - start),
    count_above = count * frac_above
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    total = sum(count),
    pct_below = round(100 * sum(count_below) / total, 2),
    pct_above = round(100 * sum(count_above) / total, 2)
  )

pct_tbl
```

## Rebin to 0.5 µm
```{r}
rebin_hist <- function(df, new_binwidth = 0.5) {

  df <- df %>%
    filter(is.finite(start), is.finite(end), is.finite(count),
           end > start, count >= 0) %>%
    arrange(start)

    start = edges[-length(edges)],
    end   = edges[-1],
    count = 0

    b <- df$end[i]
    c <- df$count[i]

    if (w <= 0 || c == 0) next

    j0 <- max(1, floor((a - min_edge) / new_binwidth) + 1)
    j1 <- min(nrow(out), ceiling((b - min_edge) / new_binwidth))

    for (j in j0:j1) {

      ob <- min(b, out$end[j])

      if (overlap > 0) {

df_05um_Fid_ROI_1 <- rebin_hist(Fid_ROI_1_raw, new_binwidth = 0.5)

# Sanity check (should match closely)
c(
  original_total = sum(Fid_ROI_1_raw$count),
  rebinned_total = sum(df_05um_Fid_ROI_1$count)
)
```

## Gaussian fit + plot
```{r}
binw <- 0.5
threshold <- 18

# weighted mean and SD from the binned histogram
N  <- sum(df_05um_Fid_ROI_1$count)
mu <- weighted.mean(df_05um_Fid_ROI_1$mid, w = df_05um_Fid_ROI_1$count, na.rm = TRUE)
sd <- sqrt(sum(df_05um_Fid_ROI_1$count * (df_05um_Fid_ROI_1$mid - mu)^2) / (N - 1))

# Data-driven x-range (use ends, not mids)
xmin <- min(df_05um_Fid_ROI_1$start, na.rm = TRUE)
xmax <- max(df_05um_Fid_ROI_1$end,   na.rm = TRUE)

# Gaussian curve only over the plotted data range
xgrid <- seq(xmin, xmax, by = 0.01)
gauss_df <- data.frame(
  x = xgrid,
  y = N * binw * dnorm(xgrid, mean = mu, sd = sd)
)

# Data-driven fill limits
fill_limits <- range(df_05um_Fid_ROI_1$mid, na.rm = TRUE)

# Reasonable breaks without hard-coding
x_breaks <- pretty(c(xmin, xmax), n = 7)

new_grad <- c("#EFEDC8", "#84B56E", "#408B80", "#31618C", "#0E1424")

Fid_ROI_1 <- ggplot(df_05um_Fid_ROI_1, aes(x = mid, y = count, fill = mid)) +
  geom_col(width = binw) +
  # Only draw the threshold line if it actually falls in range
  { if (threshold >= xmin && threshold <= xmax)
      geom_vline(xintercept = threshold, color = "#B64249", linewidth = 0.3)
    else NULL
  } +
  geom_line(
    data = gauss_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = "#5E5E5E"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = x_breaks,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.005, 0)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = new_grad,
    limits  = fill_limits,
    oob     = scales::squish,
    name    = "Absolute \nDistance (µm) "
  ) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Gauss: mean = %.2f / std.dev. = %.2f", mu, sd),
    x = "Bioprint Result to Bioprint Map Absolute Distance (µm)",
    y = "Number of Sampled Mesh Vertices"
  ) +
  # If you want to "zoom", do it here (no row dropping, no warnings):
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(max(0, xmin), xmax))

ggsave(
  "Fid_ROI_1_Histogram.png",
  Fid_ROI_1,
  width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 600
)

Fid_ROI_1
```

## 18 µm cutoff Stats
```{r}
pct_tbl_Fid_ROI_1 <- df_05um_Fid_ROI_1 %>%

    frac_above  = pmax(0, end - pmax(start, threshold)) / (end - start),
```

## Guassian fit + plot
```{r}
binw <- 0.5
threshold <- 18

# weighted mean and SD from the binned histogram
N  <- sum(df_05um_Fid_ROI_2$count)
mu <- weighted.mean(df_05um_Fid_ROI_2$mid, w = df_05um_Fid_ROI_2$count, na.rm = TRUE)
sd <- sqrt(sum(df_05um_Fid_ROI_2$count * (df_05um_Fid_ROI_2$mid - mu)^2) / (N - 1))

# Data-driven x-range (use ends, not mids)
xmin <- min(df_05um_Fid_ROI_2$start, na.rm = TRUE)
xmax <- max(df_05um_Fid_ROI_2$end,   na.rm = TRUE)

# Gaussian curve only over the plotted data range
xgrid <- seq(xmin, xmax, by = 0.01)
gauss_df <- data.frame(
  x = xgrid,
  y = N * binw * dnorm(xgrid, mean = mu, sd = sd)
)

# Data-driven fill limits
fill_limits <- range(df_05um_Fid_ROI_2$mid, na.rm = TRUE)

# x axis breaks
x_breaks <- pretty(c(xmin, xmax), n = 7)

# legend breaks every 2 µm
legend_breaks <- seq(
  from = ceiling(fill_limits[1] / 2) * 2,
  to   = floor(fill_limits[2] / 2) * 2,
  by   = 2
)

new_grad <- c("#EFEDC8", "#84B56E", "#408B80", "#31618C", "#0E1424")

Fid_ROI_2 <- ggplot(df_05um_Fid_ROI_2, aes(x = mid, y = count, fill = mid)) +
  geom_col(width = binw) +

      geom_vline(xintercept = threshold, color = "#B64249", linewidth = 0.3)
    else NULL
  } +
  geom_line(
    data = gauss_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = "#5E5E5E"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = x_breaks,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.005, 0)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = new_grad,
    limits  = fill_limits,
    breaks  = legend_breaks,   # <<<<< key change
    oob     = scales::squish,
    name    = "Absolute \nDistance (µm) "
  ) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Gauss: mean = %.2f / std.dev. = %.2f", mu, sd),
    x = "Bioprint Result to Bioprint Map Absolute Distance (µm)",
    y = "Number of Sampled Mesh Vertices"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(max(0, xmin), xmax))

ggsave(
  "Fid_ROI_2_Histogram.png",
  Fid_ROI_2,
  width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 600
)
```

# 5.) All data together
```{r}
binw <- 0.5

roi_cols <- c(
  "Main ROI"  = "#718F77",
  "Fid ROI 1" = "#796089",
  "Fid ROI 2" = "#DD9358",
  "Fid ROI 3" = "#6A7AA1"
)

# Combine all rebinned histograms (counts)
overlay_hist_df <- bind_rows(
  df_05um %>% mutate(dataset = "Main ROI"),
  df_05um_Fid_ROI_1 %>% mutate(dataset = "Fid ROI 1"),
  df_05um_Fid_ROI_2 %>% mutate(dataset = "Fid ROI 2"),
  df_05um_Fid_ROI_3 %>% mutate(dataset = "Fid ROI 3")
) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = names(roi_cols))) %>%
  arrange(dataset, start)

# Total histogram (summed counts)
total_hist <- overlay_hist_df %>%
  group_by(start, end) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    mid   = (start + end) / 2,
    width = end - start
  ) %>%
  arrange(start)

# Common x-range/grid
xmin <- min(total_hist$start, na.rm = TRUE)
xmax <- max(total_hist$end,   na.rm = TRUE)
xgrid <- seq(xmin, xmax, by = 0.01)

# Overall Gaussian from total (summed counts across datasets)
N_tot  <- sum(total_hist$count, na.rm = TRUE)
mu_tot <- weighted.mean(total_hist$mid, w = total_hist$count, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_tot <- sqrt(sum(total_hist$count * (total_hist$mid - mu_tot)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / pmax(1, N_tot - 1))

gauss_total <- data.frame(
  x = xgrid,
  y = N_tot * binw * dnorm(xgrid, mean = mu_tot, sd = sd_tot)
)

x_breaks <- pretty(c(xmin, xmax), n = 7)

Hist_GrayBars_OnlyTotalGauss <- ggplot() +
  # Gray histogram for total
  geom_col(
    data = total_hist,
    aes(x = mid, y = count),
    width = 0.55,
    fill = "#AFABAB",
    alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  # Optional: fill under the overall Gaussian
  geom_ribbon(
    data = gauss_total,
    aes(x = x, ymin = 0, ymax = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "forestgreen",
    alpha = 0.10
  ) +
  # Overall Gaussian (single curve)
  geom_line(
    data = gauss_total,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.1,
    colour = "forestgreen"
  ) +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = 18, color = "#B64249", linewidth = 0.3) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Total histogram + Gaussian fit (mean=%.2f, sd=%.2f)", mu_tot, sd_tot),
    x = "Bioprint Result to Bioprint Map Absolute Distance (µm)",
    y = "Number of Sampled Mesh Vertices"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(max(0, xmin), xmax))

ggsave(
  "All_ROIs_GrayBars_OnlyTotalGaussian.png",
  Hist_GrayBars_OnlyTotalGauss,
  width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 600
)

Hist_GrayBars_OnlyTotalGauss
```

## 18 µm cutoff Stats
```{r}
pct_tbl_ALL <- overlay_hist_df %>%
  mutate(
    frac_below  = pmax(0, pmin(end, threshold) - start) / (end - start),
    count_below = count * frac_below,
    frac_above  = pmax(0, end - pmax(start, threshold)) / (end - start),
    count_above = count * frac_above
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    total     = sum(count),
    pct_below = round(100 * sum(count_below) / total, 2),
    pct_above = round(100 * sum(count_above) / total, 2)
  )

pct_tbl_ALL
```
